usageNotes: Use this to poll the live runtime state of an LXC container, including CPU/memory usage, uptime, disk I/O counters, and network traffic since last start. Requires VM.Audit on /vms/{vmid} and the target node must be online; calling against a node that is down or fenced will return an error rather than cached data. Check the 'lock' field before issuing any lifecycle operations — a non-null lock (e.g. 'backup', 'migrate') means another operation is in progress and start/stop calls will be rejected.

examples.summary: Get current status of LXC container 110 on node pve1

tips: CPU usage is returned as a fraction (e.g. 0.025 = 2.5%) — multiply by 100 to display as a percentage.
diskread/diskwrite are cumulative byte counters since the container last started, not rates; compute delta between two polls for throughput.
pressurecpu/pressureio/pressuremem fields (Linux PSI) are only present on kernels that support cgroup2 pressure stall information.
A 'template' value of true means the container is a template clone source and cannot be started directly.
The 'ha' object is always present but may be empty ({}) if the container is not managed by the HA manager.
